MPESB Reopens Applications for 1,700 Group 3 Sub‑Engineer and Other Posts (Oct 13‑27, 2026)

Key takeaways Overview The Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) has announced a **re‑open** of its online application window for the recruitment of **1,700 Group 3 positions**, including Sub‑Engineer and other posts. The re‑open period runs from **13 October 2026** to *

Overview

The Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) has announced a re‑open of its online application window for the recruitment of 1,700 Group 3 positions, including Sub‑Engineer and other posts. The re‑open period runs from 13 October 2026 to 27 October 2026. Candidates must complete the application and pay the required fee before the closing date.

Key Dates and Deadlines

| Event | Date | |-------|------| | Original online‑application deadline (first round) | 12 September 2026 | | Re‑open application start | 13 October 2026 | | Re‑open application & fee‑payment deadline | 27 October 2026 |

All dates are listed on the MPESB official portal (https://esb.mp.gov.in/e_default.html). Applicants are advised to verify the schedule directly on the site, as any changes will be posted there.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Age: Minimum 18 years; maximum age varies between 40 years and 45 years depending on the reservation category (General, SC, ST, OBC, PwBD, and all‑female candidates) as of 1 January 2026.
  • Educational Qualification: A Bachelor’s degree in any discipline or an ITI/Diploma in any discipline from a university or institute recognized by the Government of India.
  • Other Requirements: Candidates must meet any additional criteria specified in the official notification, such as physical standards or character certificates.

Application Process

  • Visit the MPESB website (https://esb.mp.gov.in/e_default.html) and locate the “Group 3 Sub‑Engineer & Other Posts – 2026” recruitment page.
  • Register with a valid email address and mobile number.
  • Fill in personal, educational, and category details as per the official form.
  • Upload scanned copies of required documents (photograph, signature, certificates, etc.) in the prescribed format and size.
  • Pay the application fee online using the available payment modes (credit/debit card, net banking, or UPI). The fee amount is mentioned in the official notification.
  • Submit the application and note the confirmation number for future reference.

Practical Implications for Job Seekers

  • Large Vacancy Pool: With 1,700 openings, the recruitment offers a significant entry point for fresh graduates and diploma holders seeking stable government employment in Madhya Pradesh.
  • Category‑Based Age Relaxation: The upper age limit of 45 years for reserved categories widens the eligibility window for many aspirants who may have missed earlier opportunities.
  • Online‑Only Process: All steps, including fee payment, are conducted electronically, reducing the need for physical visits to MPESB offices.
  • No Exam Details Yet: The notification does not disclose the examination date, pattern, or syllabus. Candidates should monitor the MPESB website for subsequent releases.

Confirmed Facts vs. Open Questions

| Confirmed (from official source) | Still Unclear (requires future notice) | |-----------------------------------|----------------------------------------| | Number of posts: 1,700 | Exact breakdown of posts (how many Sub‑Engineer vs. other categories) | | Application re‑open dates: 13‑27 Oct 2026 | Application fee amount | | Minimum age: 18 years | Detailed exam schedule, selection stages, and cut‑off criteria | | Educational requirement: Bachelor’s/ITI/Diploma | Any specific technical subjects or experience required for Sub‑Engineer role |

Prospective applicants should download the official PDF notification from the MPESB portal to review the complete list of posts, fee structure, and any additional eligibility nuances.

How to Verify the Information

  • Go to the MPESB official website: https://esb.mp.gov.in/e_default.html.
  • Navigate to the “Recruitment” or “Notifications” section.
  • Locate the document titled “Group 3 Sub‑Engineer & Other Posts Recruitment 2026” (or a similarly worded PDF).
  • Cross‑check the dates, vacancy numbers, age limits, and qualification criteria listed there against the details presented in this article.

Staying updated with the MPESB portal is the most reliable way to receive any amendments, such as extensions of the application window or changes to fee amounts.
